cards.def: how hot, cold, wet, sunny or windy it is outside at a particular time
cards.ex: The weather in my city is very hot in July.
cards.exVn: Thời tiết ở thành phố của tôi rất nóng vào tháng Bảy.

cards.def: water that falls from clouds in small drops
cards.ex: We stayed at home because of the heavy rain.
cards.exVn: Chúng tôi ở nhà vì mưa to.

cards.def: soft white pieces of frozen water that fall from the sky when it is very cold
cards.ex: I have never seen snow in my hometown.
cards.exVn: Tôi chưa bao giờ thấy tuyết ở quê mình.

cards.def: having a high temperature
cards.ex: It is too hot to go outside at midday.
cards.exVn: Trời quá nóng để ra ngoài vào buổi trưa.

cards.def: the hottest season of the year, between spring and autumn
cards.ex: My family goes to the beach every summer.
cards.exVn: Gia đình tôi đi biển vào mỗi mùa hè.

cards.def: the coldest season of the year, between autumn and spring
cards.ex: In winter, people in the north wear thick coats.
cards.exVn: Vào mùa đông, người dân miền Bắc mặc áo khoác dày.

cards.def: a long natural line of water that flows across the land to the sea
cards.ex: There is a big river near my village.
cards.exVn: Có một con sông lớn gần làng tôi.

cards.def: a very high hill
cards.ex: We climbed a mountain in Sa Pa last year.
cards.exVn: Năm ngoái chúng tôi đã leo một ngọn núi ở Sa Pa.

cards.def: an area of sand or small stones next to the sea
cards.ex: I like walking on the beach in the evening.
cards.exVn: Tôi thích đi dạo trên bãi biển vào buổi tối.

cards.def: the coloured part of a plant that often smells nice
cards.ex: My grandmother grows beautiful flowers in her garden.
cards.exVn: Bà tôi trồng những bông hoa đẹp trong vườn.

cards.def: a tall plant with a wooden trunk, branches and leaves
cards.ex: Children are playing under a big tree in the park.
cards.exVn: Bọn trẻ đang chơi dưới một cái cây lớn trong công viên.

cards.def: a living creature that can move, such as a dog, a bird or a fish
cards.ex: My favourite animal is the elephant.
cards.exVn: Con vật yêu thích của tôi là con voi.

cards.def: bright because the sun is shining
cards.ex: It was a sunny day, so we had a picnic.
cards.exVn: Hôm đó trời nắng nên chúng tôi đi dã ngoại.

cards.def: with many clouds in the sky
cards.ex: It is cloudy today, so it may rain later.
cards.exVn: Hôm nay trời nhiều mây nên lát nữa có thể sẽ mưa.

cards.def: with a lot of wind
cards.ex: It is very windy near the sea in autumn.
cards.exVn: Vào mùa thu, gần biển rất nhiều gió.

cards.def: one of the four parts of the year: spring, summer, autumn and winter
cards.ex: Which season do you like best?
cards.exVn: Bạn thích mùa nào nhất?

cards.def: how hot or cold something is, often measured in degrees
cards.ex: The temperature can reach 38 degrees in Ho Chi Minh City.
cards.exVn: Nhiệt độ ở Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh có thể lên tới 38 độ.

cards.def: very bad weather with strong winds and heavy rain
cards.ex: Many trees fell down during the storm last night.
cards.exVn: Nhiều cây đã đổ trong cơn bão đêm qua.

cards.def: a large area of land covered with trees
cards.ex: Many wild animals live in this forest.
cards.exVn: Nhiều loài động vật hoang dã sống trong khu rừng này.

cards.def: a large area of water with land all around it
cards.ex: People often go jogging around the lake in the morning.
cards.exVn: Mọi người thường chạy bộ quanh hồ vào buổi sáng.

cards.def: a piece of land with water all around it
cards.ex: Phu Quoc is a famous island in the south of Vietnam.
cards.exVn: Phú Quốc là một hòn đảo nổi tiếng ở miền Nam Việt Nam.

cards.def: an area of high land that is lower than a mountain
cards.ex: Our house is at the top of a small hill.
cards.exVn: Nhà chúng tôi ở trên đỉnh một ngọn đồi nhỏ.

cards.def: a living thing that grows in the ground and usually has leaves and roots
cards.ex: I keep some green plants in my bedroom.
cards.exVn: Tôi để vài chậu cây xanh trong phòng ngủ.

cards.def: a very small creature with six legs, such as a fly or an ant
cards.ex: There are a lot of insects in the garden in summer.
cards.exVn: Có rất nhiều côn trùng trong vườn vào mùa hè.

cards.def: the space above the earth where you can see the sun, moon, stars and clouds
cards.ex: The sky is clear and blue after the rain.
cards.exVn: Bầu trời trong xanh sau cơn mưa.
